_comment: v0.17 L3 FEEL EVIDENCE, NIGHT leg + the reduce-motion control. Same cell and framing as the day/dusk legs. The control shot is taken on the SAME BUILD of the boulevard shot 01 was taken on: reduce-motion is toggled standing on the exterior with no door crossing after it, so 01-vs-03 proves the setting answers LIVE (v0.17 fix wave, finding #3 -- the earlier version of this script crossed a door to force a rebuild, which was the defect's workaround written into the evidence). Under reduce-motion the ambient particles stop, the foliage/water shader clocks stop, and the faced-cell bracket holds a static alpha instead of pulsing.

steps._comment: #608 art read: invrisil_street dropped its biome dust-mote default (motes with no source over a lamp-lit street), so the boulevard builds no emitter at any phase.
== EMITTER GATE on a still-emitting sky map. A teleport to Liscor's street and straight back to the start cell: no screenshot is taken there, and every shot below keeps its route and framing.

The sky-bearing biome default is forced to dusk/night, so at NIGHT Liscor's `street` emitter is actually running; the day leg pins the same map at 0. #608 moved this pin off the boulevard, which builds no emitter now.
Back out through the same door FIRST: the stationer's own exit sits below the arrival cell. Everything after this point happens on one single build of the boulevard.

== REDUCE-MOTION CONTROL, live. The pause menu opens over the boulevard and the toggle is flipped without leaving it, so no _rebuild_field runs between shot 01 and shot 03 -- world.gd's _tick_motion_settings is the only thing that can stop the sway and the shimmer (#608: the boulevard builds no ambient emitter, so there are no motes to stop here; the emitter gate is pinned on the street leg above). Pause row 8 = 'Settings' (index 7); inside, down x5 from 'Master volume' = 'Reduce Motion' (index 5) -- settings_loop's own pins, reused rather than re-derived. ==
